about: Second-wave head 5. For each [web:] or [lib:] footnote whose passage this turn returned, P(the passage supports the sentence) from the Library passage score through the E1 Platt fit. That fit was made for question-to-passage evidence, so it is provisional here: below 0.32 does_not_address, act 0.99 is out of reach (supports is never said), between unsure. A similarity scorer cannot tell contradiction from support, so contradicts is reserved for a later scorer and never said. Label only: in act mode it could only annotate a footnote as not supported by the cited source; it never deletes a citation or a claim. Refit from shadow receipts and a claim-support bench before any act.
